title: Vague request that needs a clarifying question (it's a transfer)
why: 'Can I get my money back' could mean a purchase refund, a transfer, or a dispute, and there's no transaction ID. The agent has to ask before doing anything. It turns out to be money sent to the wrong person. Fini confirmed there is no transfer-reversal operation, so it goes to a person and the agent must not suggest the money can be pulled back.
turns: hey can i get my money back
I sent $50 to the wrong person by mistake. It was meant for my sister but it went to Sam Lee.
maya.patel@example.com / 4821. The transaction id is txn_1007
